anacorp-ana-corp:lever:244f4234-c412-4ce.title: General Interest - Cypress, CA
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:244f4234-c412-4ce.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is continuously growing and scaling and we encourage you to submit a general interest application even if you don't find a suitable job posting that matches your skills and experience. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals who can bring unique perspectives and valuable contributions to our team. So, feel free to apply and let us explore the possibilities together!

assistworld-assist-world:lever:1f5f0b40-.description: About the Role Our client is a fast-growing, venture capital-backed technology company building innovative healthcare solutions. As they continue to scale, they're looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing structure, organisation, and efficiency to a growing business. This is more than a traditional EA role—you'll become a trusted partner across executive support, hiring operations, HR administration, and day-to-day business operations. We're looking for a proactive, highly organised Executive Assistant who can anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and communicate confidently across the team. You'll work closely with company leadership, helping ensure the business runs smoothly while supporting hiring, scheduling, administration, and operational projects. Key Responsibilities Executive Support ● Manage complex calendars and meeting scheduling ● Coordinate internal and external meetings ● Book domestic and international travel ● Manage executive inboxes (Gmail & Outlook) ● Prepare meeting agendas and follow-up actions Hiring & Recruitment Operations ● Schedule interviews with candidates and hiring managers ● Coordinate recruitment processes ● Liaise with candidates professionally ● Keep applicant tracking systems and hiring documentation organised HR & Operations ● Support employee onboarding and offboarding ● Assist with HR administration and documentation ● Maintain company records and internal documentation ● Coordinate office supplies and operational purchases ● Assist with company-wide administrative projects General Administration ● Prepare documents and presentations ● Manage digital filing systems ● Coordinate with external suppliers and service providers ● Learn and utilise new software platforms as the business grows

● Experience using Google Workspace and Microsoft Outlook
● Strong written communication skills
● Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

● Recruitment or HR administration experience
● Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS)

compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Vice President, Information Technology
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com. ROLE OVERVIEW The Vice President of Information Technology leads the organization's IT operations, ensuring the technology environment supporting clinical and business operations runs reliably, securely, and efficiently. Reporting to the CIO, this role is accountable for infrastructure performance, clinical and business system administration, security operations, service desk performance, and vendor management across the surgery center or ambulatory surgery network. The VP of IT leads a team of IT professionals and is responsible for reliable, on-time, on-budget delivery of technology services and initiatives while delivering on priorities set by the CIO and executive leadership. WHAT YOU'LL DO IT Operations & Team Leadership - Lead the day-to-day operations of the IT department, including infrastructure, service desk, and systems administration teams - Manage the IT operating budget and oversee execution of the approved capital plan - Hire, develop, and manage performance of IT directors, managers, system administrators, and support staff - Report on operational metrics (uptime, ticket resolution, project status, budget performance) to the CIO on a regular cadence - Partner with the CIO on technology strategy, roadmap planning, and architecture direction - Develop and execute the organization's IT strategy aligned with business objectives - Establish IT governance, policies, standards, and best practices - Manage IT budgets, capital planning, vendor relationships, and contract negotiations - Lead digital transformation initiatives and identify emerging technologies that create business value Systems & Infrastructure Operations - Oversee administration and support of all clinical platforms (e.g., EHR, Practice Management, Inventory Management) and business platforms (e.g., ERP, HRIS, Intranet) - Manage integrations between third-party medical devices (surgical equipment, imaging systems, monitoring devices) and core data sets and infrastructure - Maintain 99.9% uptime of critical infrastructure, including cloud networks, backup servers, and telecommunications systems - Establish workflows and troubleshooting protocols that minimize disruption to live surgical schedules - Lead execution of M&A integrations, clinical system and facility upgrades, moves, rollouts, system migrations, and multi-site data consolidations - Oversee data management, reporting, and analytics platforms supporting clinical and business decision-making Security & Compliance Operations - Operate the organization's cybersecurity program, including identity and access management, multi-factor authentication, endpoint encryption, and network segmentation - Maintain operational compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, and CMS standards - Lead execution and monitoring of Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) plans, including regular testing and after-action reporting - Oversee ongoing security operations: vulnerability scanning, patch management, incident response, and delivery of cybersecurity awareness training Vendor Management - Manage vendor relationships and hold vendors accountable to service level agreements and scope of services - Monitor vendor performance, renewal timelines, and cost trends, and report findings to the CIO WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Bachelor's degree

Manage client accounts by building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, internal partners, brokers, and peers through proactive communication and tailored service recommendations aligned to business needs. Strong work ethic and commitment to teamwork, contributing positively to a collaborative and supportive work environment. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d250f096-671.title: Sales Development Representative
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d250f096-671.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full. This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams. Generate and Qualify Pipeline Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles. Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit. Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels. Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points. Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions. Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting. Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing. Partner with the Sales Team Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline. Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward. Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved. Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM. Bring the Market Back In Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies. Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating. Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations. Core Requirements 1–4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role. A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations. Proven background in sales prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach. Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling. Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before. Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging. Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way. The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets. The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams. A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly. Nice to Have Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companies, virtual assistant companies, digital agent companies, or high-ticket professional services organizations. ghj-ghj:lever:0ff68926-1270-46a4-b5c7-c7.description: GHJ is looking for a Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) Senior / Supervising Senior Associate WHY we get up in the morning At GHJ we help our people and clients pursue their passions, build thriving businesses, and create a better future. WHAT we believe We believe that collaboration is the foundation for success. We work as a business advocate for our clients – providing personalized service and building long-term relationships to help position our clients for the future. HOW we succeed We are deeply committed to our core values of Bright Minds, Brave Hearts and Bold Actions and incorporate them into every aspect of our business. By living these values, we are able to meet our strategic objectives of Remaining Fiercely Independent (financial success), Meeting client demands/needs (client success), Reinforcing and expanding cultural distinction (people success). Summary of Role: The GHJ Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) team provides a challenging, rewarding and entrepreneurial opportunity for individuals to improve their skill set and career trajectory while advising companies across numerous industries through their transaction process.
responsibilities: Participating in buy-side and sell-side transaction engagements with corporate entities, investment bankers, private equity firms and strategic corporate buyers.
Assist in preparing for, and participate in, discussions with company management, and buyer/seller advisors
Prepare calculations of EBITDA adjustments, and work with data to prepare financial models, identify trends and stimulate conversation leading to potential earnings adjustments.
Work with and oversee offshore team to provide guidance on analyses required, how to interpret client data, and to navigate roadblocks encountered
Assist in preparing recasted financial statements including earnings and working capital to present the company’s adjusted operating performance and needs
Prepare operating and financial metrics including graphs, charts for discussion highlighting trends, areas of concern, etc
Identify and conduct appropriate validation procedures around key financial statement items
Documents work completed by preparing write ups and easily to follow methodology, taking into account possible alternatives and specific client circumstances
Assists in proofing financial statements and other documents if appropriate.
Prepares and indexes client files, and internal working papers
Build relationships with, and speaks to, client personnel to obtain an understanding of their business operations, processes and functions.
Applies knowledge of the client’s industry when reviewing information, including preparing for clients discussions and focusing on specific areas for diligence.
qualifications: Bachelor’s level education required.
Direct Transaction Advisory experience strongly preferred
Strong accounting and diligence knowledge.
Exceptional analytical and communication (written and oral) skills required.
CPA preferred but not required.

Very strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including experience working with and reconciling financial data such as monthly financial statements, trial balances, and experience with pivot tables, lookup formulas, index/match formulas, etc. and professional writing related to companies operations, performance drivers and trends

Demonstrates up-to-date knowledge of technical principles, theory and practice, and an ability to apply these appropriately in the context of a transaction and specifically Quality of Earnings projects.
Has foundational knowledge of the client’s industry, and can incorporate such knowledge when scoping and completing assignments, including working with Managers to develop agendas and areas of focus.
Identifies and resolves a wide variety of technical problems, by distilling the data, considering client specifics and applying reasonable and best practices to reach conclusions.
Demonstrates ability to apply learnings from one transaction to the next, implementing new skills and techniques
Plans and presents well-organized work product.
Delivers high quality work under pressure.
Seeks to improve skills through self-development
Acts as a team player with peers as well as engagement teams or department.
Seeks to improve skills through self-development.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d839fe1d-4be5-.title: E-Comm Static Ads Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d839fe1d-4be5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a E-Comm Static Ads Designer based in United Kingdom. This role is focused on creating high-volume, high-converting static advertising creative for e-commerce and performance marketing campaigns. You’ll design assets that are built to capture attention quickly, communicate compelling value propositions, and drive measurable action. The work spans Meta, Pinterest, Google Display, and programmatic advertising, with opportunities to explore a wide range of visual styles. You’ll balance polished brand design with direct-response and UGC-inspired creative designed for performance. Rapid experimentation is central to the role, with frequent iteration of winning concepts, headlines, backgrounds, layouts, and calls to action. You’ll work in a remote-first, asynchronous environment that prioritizes output, speed, creative thinking, and focused deep work. Your portfolio and ability to demonstrate the strategic thinking behind successful performance creative will be key to your success. Design high-performance static advertisements for Meta, Pinterest, Google Display, and programmatic campaigns, with a strong focus on engagement and conversion. Create a broad range of creative formats and styles, from UGC-inspired and unconventional direct-response graphics to polished, premium brand layouts. Develop carousels, split-screen comparisons, “Us vs. Them” graphics, checklists, press-style listicles, and other performance-oriented formats. Develop compelling visual hooks that capture attention quickly and communicate a clear value proposition within seconds. Rapidly iterate on successful concepts by testing alternative headlines, backgrounds, typography, layouts, CTAs, and other creative elements. Produce multiple variations of high-performing concepts efficiently to support ongoing creative testing and campaign scaling. Maintain an organized design library that enables efficient versioning, reuse, and optimization across advertising platforms. Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, composition, and contrast to guide users toward the intended action. Use performance insights and campaign feedback to refine creative direction and improve future iterations. Collaborate asynchronously with the wider team while maintaining a consistent daily overlap of approximately 2–3 hours for feedback, creative discussions, and troubleshooting. Requirements Demonstrated experience designing direct-response creative for DTC, e-commerce, lead-generation, or performance marketing campaigns. Strong performance-first mindset, with an understanding that effective advertising creative must drive clicks, engagement, and conversions rather than simply look aesthetically appealing. Expert-level proficiency in at least one major design tool, such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop, or Canva, with the ability to work quickly without compromising quality. Proven ability to produce high volumes of creative and develop 10 or more variations of a successful concept efficiently. Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, layout, color contrast, hooks, CTAs, and other principles used to encourage user action. Experience creating static paid-social advertisements, particularly images and carousels designed for measurable performance. Strong creative judgment and the ability to adapt visual styles to different audiences, products, platforms, and campaign objectives. Ability to interpret performance feedback and translate it into actionable creative iterations. Experience with DTC or UGC-style advertising is highly desirable. Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating static paid-social or performance-media work, including examples of creative hooks, winning concepts, and iterative variations. Ability to explain the strategic reasoning behind design decisions and connect creative choices to campaign objectives. Comfortable working independently

pineservices-pine-services:lever:4468e3f.title: Chief Revenue Officer
pineservices-pine-services:lever:4468e3f.description: Our Portfolio Company is Hiring! Chief Revenue Officer Western Computer | Remote About Western Computer Western Computer is a top-ranked Microsoft Dynamics partner with nearly 40 years of experience helping distribution and manufacturing companies run better on Microsoft technology. Recognized as a Microsoft Inner Circle partner (top 1% globally) and a three-time Microsoft Partner of the Year Finalist, we have completed 1,750+ implementations and built lasting relationships with clients across North America. We are a focused, expert-driven organization that measures success in years, not go-lives. The Opportunity Western Computer is seeking a Chief Revenue Officer to lead and unify our go-to-market organization at a pivotal moment in the company's growth. Reporting directly to CEO Kristen Sage, the CRO will own the full revenue function -- spanning Sales, Marketing, and Product -- and will be responsible for building the strategy, structure, and execution rigor needed to scale the business. This is a hands-on executive role for a revenue leader who thrives in complex, relationship-driven environments and knows how to drive growth in the Microsoft partner ecosystem or adjacent ERP/technology services space. What You'll Own Lead and align Sales, Marketing, and Product under a unified revenue strategy that appeals to new customers and expands Western’s partnership with their existing customers Partner with Kristen and the executive team to define and execute Western Computer's commercial growth roadmap Drive new logo acquisition while deepening wallet share across an established and loyal install base Build and strengthen the partner ecosystem, with a focus on Microsoft channel leverage Implement forecasting discipline, pipeline visibility, and RevOps infrastructure to support predictable growth Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing revenue leadership team Serve as an external face of Western Computer with strategic clients, prospects, and partners What We're Looking For Proven CRO or senior revenue leadership experience in ERP, technology services, or the Microsoft partner ecosystem strongly preferred Track record of scaling both new logo and expansion revenue in a services-led or solutions business Experience leading and aligning sales, marketing, and product functions Strong operational instincts -- comfortable building forecasting rigor and go-to-market structure without over-engineering Executive presence and credibility with C-suite buyers in distribution, manufacturing, or adjacent verticals Collaborative, hands-on leadership style that fits a high-trust, relationship-first culture Stability and tenure in prior roles -- we value leaders who build things and see them through

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c6f268a7-c8b.description: We are looking for experienced language professionals to support an ongoing project focused on reviewing and refining Thai (Thailand) customer service content. This role involves improving machine-translated materials to ensure accuracy, natural language, and alignment with project guidelines.
